name: Elrond
subtitle: Keeper of Vilya
game_text:
At the start of each turn, heal Elrond.
<phase>Fellowship</phase>: Exert Elrond to discard the top card of your draw deck. If it is an <culture>Elven</culture> card, you may take it into hand and heal an Elf companion.
flavor_text: “‘You have forseen it. War is coming… many will die.’”
